notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Notes
notes.notes:
[p]- Fixed a bug where if you failed to kill the second boss (appears in higher difficulties), his HP bar would flicker in the next wave.
- Deleted the blue fire explosions of the final boss after his death.
- Increased the damage of the Tornado skill.
- Reduced the second boss's HP (appears in higher difficulties).
[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Notes:
notes.notes:
- Reduced the sound of the tornado

- Fixed an issue where the Sound Setting did not work properly

- Balanced combination skills

- Changed the color of the boss’s fireball to avoid confusion with the player’s fireball.

- Various minor fixes

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 notes
notes.notes:

- If the game window is not focused, music will be paused

- Fixed a bug where the Total Damage text was sometimes not shown correctly

notes.title: 🎉 MAGLA is Now Released – My First Solo Game Dev Journey Begins Here!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Today marks a huge milestone for me — [b]MAGLA is officially out now![/b]
This isn’t just the release of a game. It’s the release of a dream I’ve quietly carried and built, completely solo, from absolute zero.[/p][p]When I started MAGLA, I had [b]no background in programming[/b], no team, no experience. Just a deep love for games and a stubborn belief that I could create one of my own. It’s been a long, difficult, but incredibly rewarding journey.[/p][p][b]MAGLA[/b] is an elemental roguelike where you dodge death, combine magic, and carve your own path through chaos. Every system, every line of logic, every moment of gameplay — I learned and built from scratch.[/p][p]🧊🔥🌪️ I hope you’ll enjoy the elemental battles, the chaotic runs, and the tiny details I poured my heart into.[/p][p]🎉 To celebrate the launch, [b]MAGLA is 20% off for the first 14 days[/b]!
If you’ve been waiting to dive in — now’s the perfect time.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who wishlisted, played the demo, left feedback, or even just dropped by the store page. Your support means the world to a solo dev like me.[/p][p]🎮 [b]Play MAGLA now on Steam[/b]
And if you enjoy it, please consider leaving a review — it helps more than you know.[/p][p]– From a first-time solo dev,
With gratitude 🙏[/p]

notes.title: Introducing MAGLA!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce the development of our upcoming game, MAGLA!

MAGLA is an action roguelike set in a dynamic and immersive battleground where players will engage in intense combat, level up, and choose from a variety of elemental abilities. The game allows you to combine Fire, Ice, and Earth elements to unleash powerful attacks and strategies, with more features planned for future updates.

Whether you’re exploring different elemental synergies or taking on new challenges in each playthrough, MAGLA promises an engaging and evolving experience.

We will release MAGLA in Early Access, so your feedback will play a crucial role in shaping the final version. Stay tuned for future updates, as we continue to refine and expand the game!

We can’t wait to have you join us on this exciting journey!

Follow us on social media for the latest updates and news about MAGLA.
